2104-2707-7817.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Paradox Shaper by paying {2}, causing you to put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6495-7692--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6495-7692--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Shuri.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5131-6495-7692--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-2921-5131-6595--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-5131-6595--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

654-851-3129-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7706.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing White Widow.
When White Widow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When White Widow enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and up to one other creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-5319-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
5231-5319-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

141-413-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-413-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

1309-5195-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Salvager of Secrets
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Salvager of Secrets
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

6323-7398.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2 if Dina's first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
6323-7398.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker. It triggers, giving itself +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Activate Dina by paying {2}, tapping it and sacrificing Jumbo Cactuar, causing you to gain 10,000 life and put 10,000 +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.

1558-3147-3875-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3147-3875-4231-4365.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

215-2404-3464-7014.notablePrerequisites:
North Pole Patrol does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least six creatures.
215-2404-3464-7014.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate North Pole Patrol any number of times.

3101-3292-3892-6791.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-3292-3892-6791.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3101-3292-3892-6791.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

719-4508-5880-6705.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Frog creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1545-4017-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-4017-4186.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2018-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that is not a Human and does not have flying.
628-2018-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

232-3263-5553-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
232-3263-5553-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Mycosynth Lattice by paying {R}, adding {B}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Priest of Urabrask and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{R}, enabled by Mycosynth Lattice.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

671-1274-3490-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-1274-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

974-3525-5470.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ghired.
974-3525-5470.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 3.
974-3525-5470.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Ghired to copy any other token(s) that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.

1315-5478-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
1315-5478-5720-5721.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

997-5551-5552.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
997-5551-5552.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 4.

345-1992-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
"Knight" chosen with Metallic Mimic.
345-1992-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat.

1359-2292-2366-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Dryad Arbor on top of your library.
Galadriel's second ability triggers, causing you to reveal Dryad Arbor from the top of your library, and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

690-3222-4961.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than an opponent's.
690-3222-4961.description:
Cast Minion of the Wastes by paying {3}{B}{B}{B}, choosing to pay an amount of life equal to an opponent's life total as it enters the battlefield.
Cast Inscription of Abundance by paying {1}{G}, causing you to gain life equal to Minion of the Wastes' power.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained this way.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

152-2060-2744-4772.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Crystalline Crawler with haste.
Cathars' Crusade triggers twice, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate the first activated abilities of any Crystalline Crawlers eight times by removing eight +1/+1 counters from them, adding eight mana of any color.
Repeat.

4050-4311-4871-5010.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
Golgari Thug dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting itself from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

224-872-1671.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

2438-2577-4871.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2438-2577-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2438-2577-4871.notes: Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat this loop spending mana from Treasures instead of the creature tokens, giving you infinite creature tokens.
